text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I see something surprising when I pass by
the
classroom.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Take off! Rapid Running Force,
Umamusume Five!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Red as Hokkaido salmon roe—Red
Special!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Rumble, rumble!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Spe? What in the world is going on?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
It's a hero show! We gotta start thinking
about
what to do for the Fan Fest, right?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I asked Biko if she had any ideas, and
she
suggested a play where we act as
heroes! A hero
show!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I thought we should make our plan now
and
practice ahead of time instead of
waiting till the
last minute.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Now that you mention it, I guess we do
need to
prepare something, don't we?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
And it is indeed best to plan in
advance... All
right, I'll help you out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, El Condor Pasa's class decides
to put on
a hero show for the Fan Fest.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: All right, so I'll be... um...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Wisdom deeper than the ocean—Blue
Grass.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fssshhh!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: How's that?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Okay, I'm next.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Free as the clouds—White Sky.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Whoooo...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oh, all the good parts are taken! In that
case...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
I'll be the character who shows up
midseason!
First-rate gold, descending
from heaven—Gold
King!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sha-shinnng!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Wow, you really built that up.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hey, what about you, El? What are you
gonna
do?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm... gonna pass.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: What?! Why?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No, I feel... fine. I've just decided to
walk a
different path from everyone
else.
choice_data_list_en: Are you feeling under the weather?
Are you feeling under the weather?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I can't just play around with everyone
anymore.
I'm a lone Aztec hero, fighting
on my own.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: ...Chao.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa leaves. It seems she's
also drawing
a line in her private life to
separate herself from
the Triple Crown
tour.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: She left...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The hero show practice continues
without El
Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
What should we do?! We're all doomed
at this
rate!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Curse that evil Uma organization. What
kind of
despicable lowlife isn't
captivated by the glitter
of gold?!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Aren't you, like, way worse?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
My strategy doesn't seem to be working
at all.
What do we do?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ha ha ha! Looks like you're havin' a little
trouble!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Th-that voice?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Soy yo!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
The gallant hero! The raging storm! The

mysterious masked warrior—Aztec
Condor comes
to the rescue!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: El?! I thought you weren't gonna join!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Tsk tsk tsk. It was all a ploy to shock and
delight
everyone!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Even if we walk different paths, we're
still friends!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: It's like my papa told me...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"The mark of a true entertainer is not
simply
strength, but the delight of the
fans!"

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is delighted to see El Condor
Pasa jump
in. It certainly wouldn't have
been this exciting if
she had joined in
from the beginning.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's a true entertainer. Her penchant
for
bringing joy is likely to have a great
impact on
her future.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Ohohoho! So the Umamusume Five are
all
together.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't matter. I, Pearl, one of the
three
generals, shall still take over
Planet Tracen.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Aaahhh, Pearl! When did you get back
from your
trip to France?!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Welcome hooome! You gotta tell us all
about
your adventures and exploits!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, thank you, El. Of course I'll tell
you all
about it. But, before that...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm taking this planet as my own! Just try
and stop
me!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... I was just thinking maybe it was
time to
take a break.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Now that Seeking the Pearl, one of El
Condor
Pasa's most respected
upperclassmen, has joined
the show,
things are even more exciting.
